steps.name: install-climate-rollout-teacher
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 177116fb0a248e1da09361d11c9243bab4c8993d; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage5/climate_teacher.py > tools/ml/climate_teacher.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage5/test_climate_teacher.py > tests/test_climate_teacher.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_teacher.py tests/test_climate_teacher.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/climate_teacher.py tests/test_climate_teacher.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-teacher-behavior
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_teacher.py tests/test_climate_simulator.py tests/test_climate_input.py -q; .venv/bin/ruff check tools/ml/climate_teacher.py tests/test_climate_teacher.py; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -- tools/ml/climate_teacher.py tests/test_climate_teacher.py; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/ml/climate_teacher.py tests/test_climate_teacher.py; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Add climate v6 rollout teacher'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
